extension.summary: Installs and updates the Telegram Media add-on
extension.description: Repository for the Telegram Media Kodi add-on.

extension.summary: Browse photos and videos from your Telegram channels, groups and chats
extension.description: Logs in with your own Telegram account (MTProto via Telethon) and lists every channel, group and chat individually, plus combined Images, Videos and Mixed sections across all of them. Videos stream through a local server with seeking support. Requires your own api_id/api_hash from my.telegram.org.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Telegram. Your session key is stored in the add-on profile folder - anyone with that file can access your Telegram account.
extension.news: 1.6.0: Search (all chats or one chat); Play all / play from here; long-press menus (go to chat, save to device, mark as read); video length, resolution and size on items; viewer slideshow (Play/Pause), Info hides captions, Menu for options; Saved Messages shortcut; Clear cache; lists and thumbnails pre-loaded at start-up. 1.5.0: Videos start faster - shared 128 MB chunk cache (Kodi's probing no longer re-downloads), first seconds of listed videos pre-loaded, Telegram data-centre connections warmed up and kept open. Thumbnail wall view, page numbers, viewer returns after a video. 1.4.0: Own full-screen photo viewer (left/right, continues onto next page, OK plays videos); videos restart stalled downloads instead of failing; no 2-minute silent waits; smaller thumbnails; more ways to find fast decryption. 1.3.0: Much faster on Android/ARM boxes (uses Kodi's own OpenSSL instead of pure-Python decryption); photos open in a slideshow so left/right switches images. 1.2.0: Unread section (chats with unread messages and their new photos/videos); combined All lists load much faster with many chats. 1.1.0: Log in by scanning a QR code with the Telegram app (no SMS/login code needed).
